scope: External security intelligence review for Manufacturing WFM sealed staging candidate

external_findings.title: web_fetch_tool blocked_domains bypass via resolver-normalized hostname
external_findings.wfm_reason: WFM sealed runtime is Node built-ins only and does not include Pydantic AI. Existing future-agent egress is default-deny; lesson is retained to require resolver-equivalent hostname canonicalization and positive allowlists.
external_findings.customer_impact: none verified on current candidate; future confidentiality boundary risk if a model-selected fetch feature relied on a denylist
external_findings.exploitability: conditional on an affected Pydantic AI version, blocked_domains being used as the boundary, and untrusted input influencing the model-selected URL

external_findings.title: SSRF cloud-metadata blocklist bypass via IPv6 zone identifiers
external_findings.wfm_reason: WFM has no Pydantic AI/Python agent runtime and no sealed networked agent executor. Existing policy forbids cloud metadata/local/private destinations unless separately deterministic and provider-bound.
external_findings.customer_impact: none verified on current candidate; future high-confidentiality risk if untrusted model-selected URLs were ever allowed local-network access without zone-normalized destination checks
external_findings.exploitability: conditional on affected upstream version, IPv6, local URL access explicitly enabled, and untrusted input influencing the URL

external_findings.title: OpenTelemetry content exclusion did not cover exceptions/status/instructions/output template
external_findings.wfm_reason: The sealed WFM candidate does not include Pydantic AI/OpenTelemetry agent instrumentation. Existing WFM policy requires secret redaction from logs/traces but did not enumerate every newly demonstrated telemetry side channel.
external_findings.customer_impact: none verified on current candidate; future confidentiality risk where observability audiences are broader than tenant/application data audiences
external_findings.exploitability: conditional on affected upstream instrumentation being enabled and sensitive content entering exception/status/instruction/template channels

external_findings.title: Event loop blocked by quadratic web_fetch response processing
external_findings.wfm_reason: WFM sealed candidate has no Pydantic AI local web-fetch tool or networked AI-agent executor.
external_findings.customer_impact: none verified on current candidate; future availability risk if attacker-controlled fetch responses can consume shared parsing/event-loop capacity
external_findings.exploitability: conditional on affected local web_fetch being registered and an untrusted prompt being able to steer the agent to attacker-controlled content

nvd_ssvc.reason: Each reviewed September 17 advisory currently states 'No known CVE'. Without a CVE identifier there is no direct NVD affected-product record or CISA SSVC enrichment for these disclosures. Recheck if identifiers are assigned.

validated_current_boundary.conclusion: No current package/version exposure or verified customer impact. Treat all four findings as future agent/web-tool prevention lessons, not as a claim that WFM is vulnerable to Pydantic AI defects.

containment_and_remediation: Retain positive allowlist-only egress for model-selected destinations; canonicalize hostnames into resolver-equivalent form and deny normalization ambiguity.
Strip IPv6 zone identifiers for destination security classification and re-check resolved/redirected IPs against metadata/private/loopback policy before connecting.

Treat telemetry redaction as end-to-end: scrub exception messages/stacks, status descriptions, dynamic instructions, output templates, tool content and provider error bodies, with synthetic canary verification.
Require response byte, time, CPU, nesting and charset budgets plus isolated processing for any future untrusted agent fetch response.
Do not add Pydantic AI, Python agent runtime, local-network fetch or model network authority to the sealed candidate as part of this mitigation.
